messages:
anya: heads up — eu4 interconnect flapping since 08:12 UTC. we're seeing runnode heartbeat losses + p95->p99 token latency jump (180ms -> ~720ms) and ~1% 503s. KV cache eviction rate spiked at the same time. suspect interconnect + recent batching scheduler tweak.
jamal: on it. getting logs from runnode fleet now. do we have a deploy id to blame?
maria: runtime deploy runtime-r1234 rolled at 07:55 UTC, includes batching scheduler change (dynamic-batcher v2).
alex: infra alert shows packet drops on eu4 backbone to storage tier (interconnect-a->b). routing retries piling up.
lei: exact error in runnode logs: "rpc: failed to dial storage: context deadline exceeded" and "kvcache: evicting prefix due to miss storm".
sre-bot: [incident] eu4 interconnect: increased packet loss -> elevated runnode latency. notified eng-infra, eng-runtime, oncall.
anya: action plan: 1) gate traffic away from eu4 for latency-sensitive routes, 2) scale hotpool in eu1/na1 as buffer, 3) disable dynamic-batcher v2 on runtime fleet, 4) restart kv cache helper on affected nodes if needed. assigning tasks.
jamal: shifting traffic now via routing-policy: set eu4 preference -100 for route inference-text and inference-chat. run: `rbctl route update --region eu4 --weight -100 --routes inference-text,inference-chat`
alex: started traffic shift, currently ~42% of eu4 traffic being rebalanced to eu1/na1. watching for error rates.
maria: rolling back dynamic-batcher v2 on canary -> rolling to all runnodes in eu4. patch: `deployctl rollback runtime r1234 --component dynamic-batcher`
lei: restarting kv-cache-helper on 10 pods showing highest eviction counters: `kubectl -n runnodes rollout restart daemonset/kv-cache-helper -l region=eu4`
anya: also temporarily bumped hotpool capacity in eu1/na1: +20 GPUs to absorb. cloud-provisioner request submitted.
oncall_bot: confirm manual failover executed; pager duties alerted.
jamal: after routing change p95 dropped to ~240ms within 120s. p99 still elevated (~600ms) but trending down. 503s down to 0.3%.
alex: interconnect packet loss metrics show flaps stopped at 08:28 UTC; upstream operator says BGP flaps due to maintenance script.
maria: rollback of dynamic-batcher finished at 08:35 UTC. runtime metrics: queue depth back to normal.
lei: kvcache eviction rate halved after restart and rollback. tail latencies correlate with eviction spikes pre-mitigation.
anya: good. keep eu4 traffic preference reduced until next health check window. we'll keep hotpool extra capacity for 2 hours then scale down.
jamal: creating incident ticket IT-7883 and linking logs + timeline.
alex: cost note — extra hotpool GPUs for 2 hours will add ~ $1.2k. flagging finance for chargeback.
maria: root cause hypothesis: combination of eu4 interconnect maintenance-triggered packet loss + dynamic-batcher v2 exposing a KV-cache thrash regression (increased miss amplification). independent issues coupled to cause tail latency.
anya: next steps: 1) postmortem with eng-runtime + eng-infra, include perf traces and KV cache heap dumps, 2) revert dynamic-batcher tuning permanently until we have a throttling guard, 3) add routing guard to automatically divert on packet-loss >0.5% for 5m. owner: maria for runtime fixes, jamal for routing guard, alex for provider escalation.
lei: I'm collecting heap dumps and kvcache stats into S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident/IT-7883/
anya: thanks all. will update when eu4 preference is restored. :thumbsup:
